WoW: Forever

Subtlety Rogue

Stealth openers and a RuptureRuptureLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration6 sec-driven bleed cycle. Icy Veins' lowest-rated Rogue spec overall, and it has no area damage of any kind.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Subtlety build has been tested — and none of our three sources publish a level-30 build yet either. No source has posted a level 30 build either — the cap only reached 30 on October 1 and none of the three has published one since — so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended.

What Subtlety is for

Mobility and stealth, bought early. CamouflageCamouflageTalentCastInstantReduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec. shortens the StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. cooldown and raises move speed; Improved AmbushImproved AmbushTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%. strengthens the opener and sits in row 2, within reach of an 11-point build. Ghostly StrikeGhostly StrikeTalentCastInstantCost40 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown20 sec cooldownDuration7 sec lands at exactly level 20 for 125% weapon damage, 180% with a dagger, plus 15% dodge for 7 seconds, and it is non-positional — the one builder here that does not ask you to be behind the target. None of it comes online until AmbushAmbushLevel 18 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMelee at level 18.

Icy Veins rates it the lowest Rogue spec overall — 2.5 out of 5 Overall, against 3.0 for the other two — while rating all three the same 4 out of 5 for levelling specifically. The heading is "Weakest Among Rogue Specs": "Subtlety gets the short end of the stick, with most of its higher-impact talents being unavailable until you can put more talent points into the tree." Wowhead agrees in stronger language, calling the spec "wholly underwhelming at this level bracket" and noting the Rogue lacks "our primary builder HemorrhageHemorrhageLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeDuration15 sec" and the talents that support RuptureRuptureLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration6 sec this early.

Two blunt reasons, both worth knowing before you commit. "One of the biggest issues the spec has is its positional requirement… you won't be able to do so very often when leveling solo." And: "Subtlety has no AoE capabilities whatsoever."

Icy Veins still rates its levelling 4 out of 5, the same as the other two.

Wowhead publishes two different level 20 builds, and neither is Subtlety-flavoured in the way Icy Veins' is. Its Backstab Build is the same dagger/Puncturing WoundsPuncturing WoundsTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point. allocation it publishes on the Assassination and Combat pages — Backstab as primary builder, 3 points into Puncturing WoundsPuncturing WoundsTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point., some into Improved Sinister StrikeImproved Sinister StrikeTalentCastInstantReduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5. "solely for when you inevitably pull aggro." Its Ambush Build instead spends points on Improved AmbushImproved AmbushTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%., for "a strong opener every time you're able to get back into Stealth."

Level 30: 0/0/21 — our own extension, not a published build. No source has posted one; the cap only reached 30 on October 1.   5. Dagger-only alternative: GougeGougeLevel 6 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration4 sec then BackstabBackstabLevel 4 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMelee. But wait for near-maximum energy first

Once HemorrhageHemorrhageLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeDuration15 sec is reachable: use it to build, then RuptureRuptureLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration6 sec immediately on long fights.

Multi-target: none. "No AoE capabilities whatsoever." Said plainly because a table with a blank in it invites you to go looking.

Stat priority

Weapon damage favouring a slow main hand, then Hit and Expertise, Agility, attack power, critical strike, Strength.

This spec's list differs from the other two, and the published example is the clearest statement of why: "Between a 15 DPS weapon that has a 1.9 speed, and a 14 DPS weapon with a 2.8 speed, the 2.8 speed one will serve you better."

What Forever changed for Rogues

  • HemorrhageHemorrhageLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeDuration15 sec is no longer a shared physical-damage debuff. It is now a personal RuptureRuptureLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration6 sec amplifier — it does nothing for the rest of your group, so do not take a raid assignment on it.
  • Improved AmbushImproved AmbushTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%. moved from row 3 to row 2, which is exactly why an 11-point Subtlety build can reach it at all. SetupSetupTalentCastInstant moved from row 4 to row 2 and now hits 100% at rank 3. SetupSetupTalentCastInstant only awards its combo point when the target you dodged or resisted a spell from is also your current target (October 1 build). Leveling solo is single-target already, so this does not change the build's SetupSetupTalentCastInstant pick. PremeditationPremeditationTalentCastInstantRange20 yd rangeCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration20 secAdds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost. moved from row 7 to row 4 and no longer needs PreparationPreparationTalentCastInstantCooldown600 sec cooldownWhen activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities..
  • SapSapLevel 10 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost65 ManaRangeMeleeDuration25 secIncapacitates the target for up to 25 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time. Does not break Stealth. no longer requires StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. and no longer breaks it: the first half is the larger change.
  • New: Dirty TricksDirty TricksTalentCastInstantReduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%., Improved DistractImproved DistractTalentCastInstantIncreases the radius of your Distract ability by 5 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional 2 levels lower., QuietusQuietusTalentCast2.5 sec castRange45 yd rangeDuration9 secInflicts 12000% weapon damage and sets the target ablaze, dealing Radiant damage over 9 sec., CutthroatCutthroatTalentCastInstant, Thousand CutsThousand CutsTalentCastInstant. Removed: Improved SapImproved SapTalent · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantGives you a 30% chance to return to stealth mode after using your Sap ability., Sleight of HandSleight of HandTalentCastInstantReduces the chance you are critically hit by attacks by 2% and increases the threat reduction of your Feint ability by 20%., DeadlinessDeadlinessTalentCastInstantIncreases your Attack Power by 10%..
  • Poisons and Lockpicking are secondary skills now, not class skills, and poison stacks with a sharpening stone. Rogues can learn axes, starting at skill 1.
  • Hit and critical strike are unified across spell, melee and ranged.

At level 60

Unknown: whether the Thousand CutsThousand CutsTalentCastInstant and HemorrhageHemorrhageLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeDuration15 sec bleed cycle is a real raid specialisation. ClassicWoW.gg puts Thousand CutsThousand CutsTalentCastInstant at 31 Subtlety points minimum (it requires PreparationPreparationTalentCastInstantCooldown600 sec cooldownWhen activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.) and MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee at 21 Assassination points — together that is 52, one more than Forever's 51-point budget, so the two cannot coexist in one build.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
